incidents.name: Poolz LockedDeal CreateMassPools integer overflow
incidents.notes: LockedDeal's CreateMassPools() sums the per-pool amounts in an unchecked uint256 addition, so an overflowing amount array let the attacker register pools crediting the contract's whole MNZ/SIP/ECIO/WOD balance while transferring almost nothing in.

sources.ref: onchain review: LockedDeal 0x8BfAA473a899439d8E07BF86a8C6cE5De42fE54B created 2021-07-29T11:05:08Z by 0xf7f1f00b13f4c3d818f052498902067ab91a3a66, unrelated to attack sender 0x190cd736f5825ff0ae0141b5c9cb7fcd042cef2a; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The realised proceeds came from selling the released project tokens over subsequent transactions, so lossUsd uses the ~$390K reported by PeckShield across BSC, Ethereum and Polygon deployments.
